nodes.title: An entry point says who may call it

fields.context: Who may call an entry point decides whose records it may touch. Left unsaid, an entry point is open to whoever reaches it, and nothing tells a reader or a review that it is.
fields.consequences: Every entry point names its audience (an error otherwise); an audience nobody calls is for no trigger a person calls; an entry point that reaches records owned by a person or a tenant has an audience that carries one, or that reaches every owner's. A shipment whose policy applies Identified proves that each audience carrying an identity is identified where it runs (C7).

rejected.Anyone by default: whatever is forgotten would be open, the classic hole
rejected.A role, as the SDLC's: a role names the people who sign evidence; an audience is a kind of caller, its members known only at run time
rejected.A word of a vocabulary: a word cannot say what its callers carry, nor be read against what an entry point reaches

nodes.title: A project judges harder than the language, never softer

fields.context: The language judges every project alike; a project that wants no missing owner, or no warning at all, has no way to say so, and a way to lower a problem would let it hide what the language guarantees.
fields.consequences: A project chooses a realization of Hardening by a binding where its build evaluates: AsTheLanguageSays, EveryWarning, or one of its own built on Raising (the codes it lists in a decision of its own); the engine keeps the harder of the two severities, and a way that would lower one is an error of the project (hardening-lowers).

rejected.A decision the engine reads: one way only, the codes listed; a project that wants every warning raised, or to raise by kind, would wait for the engine
rejected.A rule of std, Raised: a broken rule is one error for all, not each problem raised where it is, with its owner
